notes.title: Back from the FLIP 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]We come back from the FLIP after presenting our games to the public.[/h1]

[b]We warmly thank the organizing team who did a great job, especially Guillaume and Quentin for their welcome and the management of the event.[/b]

We met beautiful people in this magnificent place!

We expected to have success with retrogamers and old-schools of all kinds, but we did not expect to also delight younger people who literally stayed glued to demo screens!

Like that even reading and the intensive use of meninges can attract young people!

What a beautiful reward.

notes.title: Angor At the International Playful Festival of Parthenay (FLIP)
notes.notes:
[b]Come and meet us, and test our game at FLIP on July 20 in Parthenay, at the Multimedia village (Palais des congrès).[/b]

We were already present on Saturday, July 13, and we met players conquered by their try.

You will also discover other games of all types.
